description: Discover shared HTML pages. Search titles/descriptions or exact page IDs; omit channel_id to search all accessible standard rooms. Cursor-paginated directory returns stable IDs, descriptions, revisions and private links. Read relevant pages with page_get before contributing. Encrypted rooms are not supported.

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

query.description: Title, description, or exact page ID
